audience.title: This works for you if…
audience.item1: You already have a product and real sales — through social media, marketplaces, or word of mouth
audience.item2: You don't have a proper website, or you do — but it doesn't bring buyers
audience.item3: You're not ready to bet hundreds of thousands on marketing experiments, but you want to grow
audience.item4: You value partnership — when the contractor is invested in your outcome, not the invoice
audience.item5: You're ready for the long game: this model compounds over time, not a quick burn-through
audience.item6: You want to understand every lead and every dollar of revenue — not get 'reports filled with fluff'

how.title: Four stages of collaboration
how.lead: From the first conversation to consistent sales through the website.

step1.title: Discovery
step1.text: 30-minute call. We look at your product, current sales, and goals. We decide whether this model fits.

step2.title: Launch
step2.text: I build the website and lead-capture system at my own cost. Structure, copy, presentation. Up to two months.

step3.title: Ongoing work
step3.text: Search rankings, traffic channel experiments, technical maintenance. Continuous, compounding effort.

step4.title: Settlement
step4.text: Monthly lead reconciliation and a results report. I invoice only against sales that came through the website.

protect.title: Both sides protected
protect.lead: This model works long-term, so it matters that neither side feels exposed.

client.title: What protects you
client.item1: All lead data is accessible to you at any time
client.item2: On termination you receive the content, the domain, and a full lead export
client.item3: You can bring in an independent technical specialist for verification
client.item4: End the collaboration with 30 days' notice — no penalties
client.item5: All terms are fixed in a formal contract

us.title: What protects me
us.item1: The website and technical infrastructure stay on my side
us.item2: Leads are captured automatically — sales can't be 'lost'

us.item4: Contract is issued through a registered sole proprietor — fully legal and transparent

q1.question: How much exactly will I pay?
q1.answer: The settlement is defined individually at the discovery stage and depends on your niche, average ticket, and scope. Core principle: no sales through the website — no invoice. All terms are fixed in the contract before work starts.

q2.question: What if I already have a website?
q2.answer: Even better. Reworking an existing site for sales is often faster than starting from scratch. We'll assess what's there and decide — rebuild or evolve.

q3.question: What if there are no sales through the website in a given month?
q3.answer: I don't invoice. That's the whole point — I earn when you earn. This pushes me to constantly test channels and improve the site, not just 'work off a deposit'.

q4.question: What if I want to end the collaboration?
q4.answer: Written notice 30 days in advance. You receive all your materials — content, domain, lead exports. No penalties, no friction.

q5.question: How do I know a lead actually came through the website?
q5.answer: All leads are captured automatically with a unique number, date, and time. Each month I send the full registry and a results report — you see the complete picture.

q6.question: How long until I see results?
q6.answer: Website launch — up to two months. First leads usually arrive 1–3 months after launch. Search promotion compounds — results at 6 months are visibly stronger than at month one.
